one_liner: Count cash by note denomination in seconds and get the exact total — no mistakes, no recounting.
description: Cash Calculator lets shopkeepers, traders and families count cash quickly: enter how many notes of ₹500, ₹200, ₹100, ₹50, ₹20, ₹10 and coins you have and it instantly shows the total, also written in words (English and Hindi). Save each count with a note (e.g. 'evening galla', 'shaadi shagun'), see history, and share the breakup on WhatsApp as a neat slip. Works offline.
key_features: Denomination-wise note counting with instant total
Total written in words in English and Hindi
Save counts with a label and view history
Share the cash breakup on WhatsApp as a slip
usp: The fastest way to count a pile of mixed notes correctly, built for Indian denominations.
target_audience: Kirana shop owners, small traders, petrol pump and delivery cash handlers, and families counting wedding or festival cash, in tier-1 to tier-3 cities
